title: Aggregate insurance restitution and corrective plans can coexist with unknown individual recovery and coverage continuity
source_unit: Virginia State Corporation Commission public settlement summaries for Esurance, State Farm, and Anthem/Carelon
geography: United States; Virginia auto, property-rating, and health-insurance markets

observations.period: August 27, 2026; Esurance settlement acceptance and restitution

denominator.unit: consumers named in the Virginia SCC settlement summary

exposure.value: Esurance reportedly increased premiums or charged points after accidents without required notice

aggregate_payment_status.value: The Virginia SCC reports that Esurance has paid the approximately $2 million restitution to 2,959 consumers

corrective_route.value: Additional impact analysis was required before new rate factors, with continued notice monitoring

individual_recovery.unit: missing policyholder identity, payment receipt, premium correction, coverage continuity, residual loss, trust, and switching

observations.method: Structured extraction from the Virginia SCC public settlement summary; regulatory attribution, aggregate restitution, and prospective controls are kept separate from individual receipt and adequacy.
observations.uncertainty: Aggregate payment and corrective-plan statements are regulator-reported and do not provide a recipient file, policy-level correction, timing, or coverage outcome.
observations.subgroup: Virginia Esurance policyholders named in an aggregate settlement summary; no policyholder-level subgroup or comparison is supplied.
observations.counterinterpretation: Aggregate restitution can coexist with delayed payment, residual premium burden, or coverage disruption for individual policyholders.

observations.period: May 20, 2026; State Farm settlement acceptance and restitution

denominator.unit: consumers named in the Virginia SCC settlement summary

exposure.value: State Farm reportedly issued policies or premiums inconsistent with filed rate information

aggregate_payment_status.value: The Virginia SCC reports that State Farm has paid the approximately $2.5 million restitution to 91,696 consumers

corrective_route.value: The settlement required accurate filings, use of filed rates, and ongoing monitoring

individual_recovery.unit: missing consumer identity, payment receipt, amount, premium re-rating, coverage continuity, residual loss, trust, and switching

observations.method: Structured extraction from the Virginia SCC public settlement summary; recipient counts, aggregate restitution, and filed-rate controls are not treated as individual payment or protection.
observations.uncertainty: The summary does not provide amount by consumer, payment timing, returned payment, account correction, renewal, or coverage outcome.
observations.subgroup: Virginia personal-auto consumers named in the aggregate State Farm settlement summary; no consumer-level comparison is supplied.
observations.counterinterpretation: A large reported recipient count does not establish that every consumer received timely or adequate correction.

observations.period: March 24, 2026; Anthem/Carelon settlement acceptance, claims/network failures, and restitution

denominator.unit: consumers named in the settlement summary; 586 providers also named

exposure.value: Contracting, credentialing, demographic, network-status, and fee-schedule problems reportedly caused inaccurate or delayed provider payments
exposure.unit: reported health-insurance network and claims failure

aggregate_restitution.unit: approximately U.S. dollars reported restitution, plus approximately $118,000 to Virginia

aggregate_payment_status.value: The Virginia SCC reports that Anthem has paid the approximately $346,000 restitution to 1,680 consumers and 586 providers, plus $118,000 to the Commonwealth

corrective_route.value: The settlement reported claims, vendor, data, and testing controls for future accuracy

care_and_recovery.unit: missing patient/provider identity, claim payment, network correction, care continuity, receipt, residual cost, trust, and switching

observations.method: Structured extraction from the Virginia SCC public settlement summary; consumer/provider counts, aggregate restitution, and system controls are kept separate from claim-level and care-level outcomes.
observations.uncertainty: The summary is not a claim-level outcome file and does not establish completed care, provider participation, payment receipt, or durable network correction.
observations.subgroup: Virginia consumers and providers named in the Anthem/Carelon aggregate settlement summary; no patient or provider trajectory is supplied.
observations.counterinterpretation: Restitution and system controls can coexist with unknown care continuity, provider exit, residual patient cost, or delayed correction.

boundary: This record establishes three Virginia SCC insurance settlements with regulator-reported aggregate restitution, reported aggregate payment, and prospective correction. It does not claim recipient-level receipt beyond the regulator's aggregate payment statement, adequate compensation, coverage or care restoration, durable error reduction, trust change, switching, or exit.

reproduction_audit.retrieval_hash_scope: The hash covers the compact project event ledger derived from the Virginia SCC public settlement summary; policyholder, patient, provider, claim, and payment files are not retained.
